scripts.setup:parser: cd apps/parser && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: pnpm install --silent && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,api,parser -c green,blue,yellow "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:parser"
scripts.dev:parser: [ -d apps/parser/.venv ] || pnpm setup:parser && cd apps/parser && .venv/bin/uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8001
